name: cohdl-site
description: cohdl.org — the CoHDL project site and pre-launch waitlist

scripts.waitlist:export: wrangler d1 execute cohdl-site --remote --command="SELECT email, created_at, source FROM waitlist ORDER BY created_at" --json
scripts.waitlist:count: wrangler d1 execute cohdl-site --remote --command="SELECT COUNT(*) AS signups FROM waitlist"
